name: Multiverse Ballance
source: After you die from overwork you must go to hell… unless you agree to sign the contract with the succubus. If you perform it well, you’ll get the opportunity to reborn in any universe you wish. What should you do? You must seduce as more universes as you can, to provide succubus with sexual energy. Use your cunning mind and some “devil traits” for performance of contract.
translation: 过劳死后，你必须下地狱……除非你同意与魅魔签订契约。如果你表现得好，你将有机会重生到任何你想要的宇宙。你应该做什么？你必须尽可能引诱更多的宇宙，为魅魔提供性能量。用你狡猾的头脑和一些“魔鬼特质”来履行契约。
